intent: Let a user choose a color via a saturation/hue field, hex/RGB/HSL text entry, alpha slider, or the OS eyedropper.
avoid_when: only a small fixed palette needs choosing from (use a simple swatch list instead)
a11y_contract: every input surface (hex field, channel fields, alpha field, eyedropper button) requires and receives an aria-label via the component's `label` prop
requires_data: a controlled color value and onChange handler; a `label` describing what the color applies to
